result.title: Discrete wave
notes: Finite difference wave; bounded traces do not establish continuum regularity.

source_contract.assumptions: Periodic 16-site wave; zero initial velocity; Courant 0.5 or 0.6.
source_contract.expected_baseline: Mean displacement stays zero and declared finite trace remains bounded.
source_contract.falsifier: A high Courant number can make an explicit wave scheme unstable.
source_contract.evidence: synthetic; no independent reproduction or empirical confirmation
